Error diffusion is a NO-OP at this sampling rate, 0.8668 rounded against 0.8668 diffused, since per-sample steps are already several pixels. Part two kills the naive two-layer design: plan plus its OWN leftover is exactly the floor, but that same leftover REVERSED, identical magnitude and spectrum and lag structure and only the alignment destroyed, costs the entire distance at 0.8298. THE PLAN LAYER IS NOT WHERE THE DEFICIT IS, which kills the ground-up plan-plus-renderer architecture for the price of a CPU afternoon and no GPU time. Every other feature is between 0.7 and 1.7 of human, so the model has ordinary variety in speed, timing, direction changes and deviation, and essentially ONE curvature. Guidance could not steer curvature because there is nothing there to steer. Note this is NOT the same defect as low adherence: angular_velocity_mean has full spread at 1.01 and adherence 0.51, max_deviation 1.14 and 0.67, so those are steering failures while curvature is a capability failure, and they need different fixes. Single-feature AUC, balanced n=2000, floor in brackets: movement_duration 0.732 (0.514) dominates everything, more than the full 18-feature score of 0.660. Cause found and it is the temporal lattice, the exact analogue of the whole-pixel spatial lattice this repo already knows about: human timestamps sit on a 1 ms grid so human durations do too, 903 distinct values in 2000 samples, while the model is continuous at 2000 distinct in 2000. The RF splits between grid points and everything in the gaps is synthetic. Snapping the model timestamps to the same 1 ms grid is a clean targeted repair and it works on the column: movement_duration 0.732 -> 0.567 and time_to_peak_velocity 0.567 -> 0.521, removing 0.165 and 0.046 of excess, the two largest carriers in the panel. This is measured proof of what the flat importance tables have implied since w3_joint_structure: the 18 features are 18 correlated views of one global mismatch, and every targeted repair in this repo failed for that structural reason rather than for its own reasons. Coupling repair worth nothing, guidance backfiring, arrival correction small, texture transplant negative, emitter negative, all the same fact. Consequence: the only thing that can move this number is making the generative distribution itself closer, which is training, capacity, data and conditioning adherence, not any further feature-level surgery. Reads cached generations only, no GPU, no generation, no checkpoint touched.

config.question: what distribution does the match loss actually see, and how far is it from what the model serves

So the training optimizes a low-fidelity proxy roughly 0.25 AUC away from its own output, and a better gradient on the wrong distribution is still the wrong gradient. That is why repairing the estimator changed nothing. Two candidate causes tested and both largely REFUTED as the main driver: supplying the character command, which training omits with feat=None while serving always passes it, moves 0.9020 to 0.8810 only; and matching the serving sampler, 12 steps at choice_temp 4 versus 100 at 10, moves 0.8762 to 0.8614 only. Separately, the frame pipeline itself is lossy: REAL tokens through stream_to_frames score 0.573 to 0.607 across batches, not the 0.497 real-vs-real floor, so even a perfect match in training space leaves a detectable gap by construction. CONSTRUCTIVE IMPLICATION: for this stage to work the loss has to be computed on serving-faithful samples through the serving reconstruction. The queued estimator is what makes that affordable, since it needs far fewer fresh samples per step, so its value is not the statistics but the budget it frees. NOTE a correction made in session: I first read partial_reveal as revealing REAL tokens. It does not, it reveals the models own samples, so reveal_frac is how much the iterative sampler does before the one-shot completion takes over.

Local sequencing therefore carries far more signal than the entire gap being chased, and the model at 0.66 sits between untouched real data and locally scrambled real data. Prime suspect is the decoder, which reveals events in gumbel perturbed confidence order conditioned on a scattered subset, never revisits them, and lets two events revealed in the same step not see each other at all.

So the reveal order cannot simply be changed. The confidence order is doing necessary work on macro path shape by laying down high confidence anchors early. Its cost is that an event chosen early is conditioned on a scattered handful of others rather than its neighbours and is never revisited, which is the local sequencing damage w4_arrangement priced. Those are separable, so the remaining three arms were killed as low value and the effort moved to a local repair pass that keeps the order and redraws small random subsets with everything else visible.
